title: SPOOKTOBER v2 - Freaky Carnival
desc: Spooktober V2 brings a creepy carnival to the Bellisseria Fairgrounds from October 1 through 31. Visitors can wander the freak-show midway, explore eerie attractions and carnival oddities, and join DJ parties every weekend, with Halloween festivities continuing through October 31.

title: THE PHOENIX
desc: Established in 2015, The Phoenix features themed venues that change with real-world holidays and seasons. Enjoy live DJs from around the world every Friday and Saturday, bringing new and old music. Join the friendly community, explore the woods, relax on the beach, and more!

title: Ohana Haunted Sanctuary
desc: Ohana Haunted Sanctuary is a spooky Halloween destination with putt-putt golf, a pumpkin patch, a hedge maze, a witch's grove, and a theater. Enjoy fishing systems and family/couple camping rentals. Enter if you dare!

title: UyTopia Haunted Halloween
desc: This Halloween, UyTopia takes a darker turn. Wander through a forgotten graveyard, where ghostly apparitions emerge without warning, eerie sounds fill the air, and a blanket of mist drifts across the ground. Explore a haunting tropical setting filled with shadows, mystery, and unexpected encounters. Some spirits are still waiting to be found.

title: Sci-Fi Mini Fair 2026
desc: Sci-Fi Fairland hosts the Sci-Fi Mini Fair 2026 for three full months, from October 1 through December 31. Visitors can explore creators, vendors, themed activities, surprises, and community events while supporting the American Cancer Society’s Relay For Life, with 100% of proceeds benefiting the cause.

title: MadPea Shadow Seekers: The Ghost Files
desc: MadPea Shadow Seekers - The Ghost Files is a paranormal grid-wide adventure running from October 3rd - November 1st. As a Shadow Seeker, you'll track supernatural manifestations across the grid, earn Shadow Points, and rise through the ranks to unlock classified Ghost Files: terrifying cases where the spirits are very real, highly aggressive, and deadly. Your mission is simple: Find the haunting. Photograph the ghost. Survive.

title: XORBtech Store
desc: Xorbtech offers animated pools with 3D water effects, waterslides, diving boards, outdoor games, and other water-themed creations. Visitors can explore the store, try interactive displays, and take a ride on the roller coaster.

title: Halloween at Icewater Village
desc: Halloween has arrived in Icewater Village! Explore the abandoned house, the spooky Mannequin Doll House, wander through the haunted cemetery, or enjoy some sinister shopping. From October 7th to 31st, take part in the Halloween Haunted Hunt—based on different true mystery stories. Are you brave enough?

title: Thee Sanctum
desc: Step beyond the ordinary and enter Thee Sanctum Resort, an immersive luxury destination created for singles, couples, groups, celebrations, and unforgettable getaways.

title: Spook Hill
desc: Ride the train or make the climb up Spook Hill, where a winding path leads through eerie scenes toward a zombie city and asylum. Search along the way for nine hidden pumpkins, each containing a spooky treat.

title: Haunted Dreams
desc: Haunted Dreams blends autumn romance with Halloween scares. Visitors can dance in fall meadows, explore a misty cemetery, brave a derelict house and an asylum, then make their way to a sinister carnival filled with creepy sights and rides.

title: The Bradbury Project
desc: The Bradbury Project is produced by Seanchai Library and invites guests to walk in the footsteps of Tom Skelton and his friends as they explore Ray Bradbury's 1970s fantasy novel "The Halloween Tree." Over 30 hours of events: music, dancing, stories, and quests. Open October 3 through November 3, 2026.

title: Spooktakulum 2026
desc: Long Beach invites you to a new shopping and treasure hunting adventure, even some treasures with trivia. Many creative accessories, decorations, plants, and outfits await you, even for Dinkies. The destination also features broomstick and carousel rides, and nice spots for taking pictures. The event runs between October 1st and 31st. Come enjoy!

title: The Last Stream
desc: DRD presents The Last Stream, an immersive Halloween hunt and story experience set in Hollowbrook. Follow the final broadcast of five streamers, solve puzzles, uncover secrets and achievements, and collect prizes while discovering what happened to them. Full information is at www.deathrowdesigns.net/hunt

title: Halloween at Lucky's
desc: Lucky's celebrates Halloween with family fun throughout the region. Visit the carnival, explore the cornfield and spooky dock, enjoy rides and weekly DJ sets, or stop by for shopping and other activities.

title: Sovereign's Rest
desc: A dark fantasy island ruled by an Overlord, where magic, mystery, and secrets are woven into everyday life. Explore the Shadow Realm, Lumina Glade, the Docks, and the Village, each with its own atmosphere and stories to uncover. Discover a world of immersive roleplay, forge alliances, and find your place in Sovereign’s Rest. Visit the OOC event area to celebrate the changing seasons, enjoy holiday festivities, and take part in fun activities throughout the year.

title: Haven Arcade
desc: Haven Arcade is an LGBTQIA+ friendly, 18+ arcade and hangout featuring a variety of games, including board games, table games, trivia, bowling, and party games. Visitors can win prizes, watch movies, enjoy coffee at the cafe, and suggest new games they'd like to see!

title: Love Heaven Haunted
desc: The Halloween section of Love Heaven is designed to create a truly immersive and mysterious atmosphere for visitors. The area takes them on a journey through a haunted world filled with darkness, fog, eerie sounds, and unexpected surprises. Visitors can explore the Cemetery of Singers, discover a terrifying Haunted House, encounter mysterious Witches, and enter the spectacular Zombie Circus. The goal is to make every area feel alive, creating a unique Halloween experience.

title: Balamoya
desc: Balamoya is reminiscent of French "guinguette" (open-air cafes). DJs take turns throughout the week, and sometimes there are live singers and K-pop groups. Balamoya brings to life the virtual world of the French artist Patrick Moya.

title: OG. Halloween
desc: Now presenting the Second annual OG. Halloween Festival! Are you ready for this Halloween season? Well, you better get ready! Because OG. is hosting its first-ever Halloween destination. OG is opening the doors to an all-new Halloween experience. A graveyard hunt and rides that will knock your pixel socks off! Don’t miss the chance to have some good ol’ fashioned Halloween fun!

title: VOTESTOCK
desc: VOTESTOCK is a music and art event designed to promote voting awareness and support Vote Ready USA, an initiative that brings together helpful information on voter rights, accessibility, election assistance, and first-time voting. The event takes place on Saturday, October 10th from 11am to 4pm SLT. Five hours, five performers, and seven artists to entertain, enlighten, and inspire!

title: Sahira Public Gardens
desc: Sahira Public Gardens is a welcoming place to relax, spend time with friends, and take photos. Explore the gardens to find a camping area, beach, lake, old house, and spots with animations to enjoy together.

title: Kickers Creek Fall Festival
desc: Step into Kickers Creek, a charming little community where there is small-town warmth that has been transformed into fall! The community comes alive with fall colors, pumpkin picking and carving, a scavenger hunt, and plenty more! Whether you're stopping by for a visit, looking for a place to call home, or simply looking for something fun to do, there is always something happening around Kickers.

title: Havenwood - This is Halloween
desc: A cold wind shifts and the leaves begin to fall! Spooky season rises as monsters creep and ghouls moan. Darkest fears begin to unfold! Halloween is drawing near, and in Havenwood it has appeared! Visitors are welcome, but be not afraid; many surprises are underway!

title: Coda Haze - Lakeside Manor
desc: Explore Lakeside Manor, a haunted estate at Coda Haze filled with strange residents, curious rooms, and unsettling secrets. Wander the misty grounds or hunt spirits in Ghosts & Ghouls. Use the shared environment for the full atmosphere—and listen carefully when the house begins to rumble.

title: MIRROMERE
desc: Rediscover MIRROMERE, a cherished jewel of Calas Galadhon Park, beautifully renewed. Wander beneath majestic Redwoods into flower-filled meadows, explore the Coast Trail on horseback, or find a secluded haven for reflection and meditation. Discover romantic hideaways, dance beneath the trees, or simply hold someone close. Let nature embrace you and MIRROMERE weave its own special magic.

title: After Dark Mini Golf
desc: Come play 14 holes of mini golf at After Dark Mini Golf, where the dark side of Halloween awaits. Enter if you dare!

title: RGF - Pumpkin Pie: Fall Seasonal Rentals
desc: Welcome to RGF Estates - Pumpkin Pie! Explore this autumn-themed region featuring seasonal home and parcel rentals, scenic views, haunted houses, and a sleepy little town. Enjoy the fall atmosphere and find a cozy place to call home! Open October 8 through December 7, 2026. This is a limited-time seasonal region, so enjoy it while it lasts. All parcels, cabins, and region items will be returned after December 7.

title: Boom Boom Social Club
desc: Boom Boom Social Club is an industrial underworld of steel, shadow, and pulse. Horror‑core basslines, Dark House, Industrial, Metal, and seductive electronic energy collide in a space built for those who move in the dark. The lights stay low, the atmosphere stays wicked, and the music feels alive beneath your feet.

title: The SWAMP
desc: The mud surrounds, hides, slows you down. The water holds what the earth can no longer contain. Images surface without ever fully emerging. Crumpled, wet, exposed. Like thoughts that have remained too long beneath the surface. Walk through the swamp, observe, ask questions, and then let your whole being flow without sinking.

title: Haunted Pyong Ya
desc: Haunted Pyong Ya is a Halloween destination filled with eerie places to explore, including caves, a haunted house, a swamp cemetery, a witch’s house, and more. Open from October 4 through 31.

title: Egress Haunted Destination
desc: Egress Haunted Destination invites visitors through the mist into a landscape filled with restless spirits, eerie pathways, and dark surprises. Enter if you dare and see what waits in the shadows.

title: Varna after Dark: a Halloween nightmare
desc: Varna After Dark transforms a rain-soaked city into a Halloween nightmare. Beyond the dark city streets, horror waits: an alien invasion, a sinister circus, a haunted cemetery, ghost-filled witch houses, and surreal creatures. An atmospheric dark-fantasy destination created for exploration, photography, and those drawn to the strange.

title: The Hex Sanctuarium
desc: Welcome to The Hex Sanctuarium. Explore an abandoned Vermont psychiatric institution and the forgotten Von Hex Manor, where decades of secrets remain buried. Search for evidence, examine old records, and follow the stories of multiple victims

title: The Clockmaker's Curse - Halloween Ride
desc: Step aboard The Clockmaker's Curse, an immersive Halloween dark ride through Black Hollow, a haunted Victorian town frozen at 11:59 for 113 years! Journey through eerie streets, a sinister clockmaker's workshop, and supernatural surprises as you race to break the curse. After the ride, explore the haunted maze and search for 12 free Halloween hunt gifts!

title: Blue Finch's 5th Annual Haven Hollows
desc: Ready for a spooky adventure? Come explore a place where there’s something fun hiding around every corner! Hop aboard an adorable Spooky Owl Bear and tour the destination with a friend, or grab a Haunted Bike and cruise through the eerie scenery. Feeling adventurous? Gather your crew and set sail on an Erie Boat Ride! Don’t forget to visit the mysterious Witch’s House, discover cozy cafés, and find the perfect spot to relax and hang out. Come explore, take a ride, make some memories—and stay awhile if you dare!
